In short

The Mirc Glow Night Cream Combo is a set of Glutathione Cream and Avocado Night Cream (30 g + 30 g). It costs ₹1,799 (MRP ₹2,148), ₹349 less than buying the jars separately, with free shipping and Cash on Delivery across India. Best for: radiance and deep nourishment in one evening routine.

  • Use: Alternate nights at first, then layer
  • Skin type: Dull, dry or uneven-looking skin
  • A jar lasts: about two months when you alternate the jars
  • Free shipping, Cash on Delivery, 7-day returns on sealed jars

The Mirc Glow night cream combo brings together our two most different creams. The Glutathione Cream, with vitamin C and kojic acid, is made for a radiant-looking finish. The Avocado Night Cream, with aloe vera and vitamin B3, is made for deep nourishment. Together they cover both things most people want from an evening routine: glow and softness.

Bought as a pair, they cost less than buying each jar separately.

What is in the combo

1. Glutathione Cream with Vitamin C and Kojic Acid, 30 g. A premium evening cream for a hydrated, smooth and radiant-looking complexion.

2. Avocado Night Cream with Kojic Acid, 30 g. A rich, comforting cream with avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid that leaves skin feeling soft by morning.

Why pair these two creams?

They do different jobs. Glutathione is an antioxidant that your body makes naturally, and in skincare it is used in formulas designed for a fresh, luminous look. Avocado is rich in oil and gives a cushioned, nourishing layer that dry skin welcomes.

One brings radiance-focused care. The other brings comfort. Skin that is both well moisturised and even-looking is what people usually mean when they talk about a healthy glow.

You can read how the main ingredients compare in kojic acid vs glutathione.

Two ways to use this night cream combo

Option 1: Alternate nights

This is the gentler way, and the one we suggest you start with.

  • Night one: Glutathione Cream.
  • Night two: Avocado Night Cream.
  • Repeat.

Both creams contain kojic acid, so alternating gives your skin an easy introduction.

Option 2: Layer them

Once your skin is comfortable, you can use both on the same evening. Apply a thin layer of Glutathione Cream first, wait a minute, and then seal it with a thin layer of Avocado Night Cream. Use less of each than you would alone.

If your skin is sensitive, stay with option one.

Your evening routine, step by step

  1. Cleanse your face. Cleanse twice if you wore sunscreen or make-up.
  2. Pat dry, leaving skin slightly damp.
  3. Apply toner or serum, if you use them.
  4. Apply tonight's cream: a pea-sized amount, pressed gently into the face and neck.
  5. In the morning, finish your routine with sunscreen.

For the technique, see how to apply night cream and how to use glutathione cream.

What you get from this combo

  • A more radiant-looking complexion with regular use.
  • Skin that feels soft, hydrated and comfortable overnight.
  • Support for a smoother, more even-looking tone.
  • Variety in your routine without buying a shelf of products.
  • About two months of evening care when you alternate the jars.

Key ingredients

  • Glutathione. A small antioxidant molecule used in creams made for a luminous look.
  • Vitamin C. A classic antioxidant for radiance.
  • Kojic acid. In both creams. Kojic acid is used in cosmetics for a brighter, more even-looking tone.
  • Avocado and aloe vera. Nourishment with a fresh feel.
  • Vitamin B3. Also called niacinamide, for a smooth-looking surface.

Please check each pack for the full and current ingredient list. You can look up any of these in the skincare ingredient glossary.

Who is it for?

Dull, tired-looking skin. The Glutathione Cream is your main cream, with the Avocado Night Cream for extra comfort.

Dry skin. The Avocado Night Cream does the heavy lifting, with the Glutathione Cream on alternate nights for radiance.

Combination and oily skin. Alternate the creams and use thin layers.

Sensitive skin. Patch test each cream separately, and introduce them one week apart.

This night cream combo is suitable for both women and men.

What to expect

First week. Skin feels softer and more hydrated.

Weeks four to eight. Skin begins to look fresher and more radiant.

Weeks eight to twelve. A more even-looking tone becomes easier to see.

Results vary, and they depend on using the creams consistently and wearing sunscreen every day. More detail is in how long glutathione cream takes to work.

Good to know

  • Sunscreen every morning is essential while using kojic acid.
  • Patch test before first use, and stop if irritation occurs.
  • Do not combine with strong exfoliating acids or retinoids on the same night until your skin has settled.
  • Store the jars closed, away from heat and sunlight.
  • These are cosmetic products and are not intended to treat any skin condition.

Please read glutathione cream side effects before you start.

Prefer to buy one cream?

Both are sold separately: the Glutathione Cream and the Avocado Night Cream. Compare all of our night creams in the Korean night cream guide.

Night cream combo FAQs

Can I use both creams on the same night?

Yes, once your skin is used to them. Start by alternating nights.

Which cream goes first when layering?

The Glutathione Cream first, then the richer Avocado Night Cream.

How long does the combo last?

Around two months if you alternate the jars each night.

Is it suitable for men?

Yes.

Is the combo cheaper than buying separately?

Yes. The combo price is lower than the two creams bought individually.
